SWAPNIL KOLE

DevOps, MERN & Blockchain Full-Stack Developer swapnilkole7500@gmail.com | +91 8328217163 | Hyderabad, India linkedin.com/in/swapnil-kole | github.com/kole-swapnil

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience building full-stack and decentralized applications across the MERN stack, Solidity smart contracts, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP). Specializes in architecting NFT and Web3 platforms end-to-end, from smart contract development, testing, and auditing to scalable backend systems and React front ends. Proven record of leading engineering teams, conducting code reviews, and delivering blockchain solutions for enterprise clients and government bodies.

CORE SKILLS

Languages: JavaScript (ES6), TypeScript, Solidity, Python, Go, C++, C, SQL Frontend: React, Next.js, HTML5, CSS3, SCSS, Bootstrap, Material UI, ReactStrap, jQuery Backend: Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs, Axios Blockchain & Web3: Solidity, Hardhat, Truffle, Web3.js, IPFS, Hyperledger, T-REX (ERC-3643), Polygon, Smart Contract Auditing, dApp Development Databases: MongoDB, SQL Cloud: AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) DevOps & IaC: Terraform, AWS, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD Tools & Practices: GitHub, Code Review, System Design, ML/AI, Agile Agentic AI Tools: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, ChatGPT, OpenClaw

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Software Engineer — Vistateq Virtuosity

Oct 2025 – Present • India • Client: BridgetowerCapital Technologies: AWS Serverless, Terraform, Solidity (T-REX / ERC-3643), React

Architected and built the complete backend infrastructure for an NFT platform using AWS serverless architecture. • Provisioned and automated cloud infrastructure as code with Terraform. • Developed T-REX (ERC-3643) compliant smart contracts, including deployment scripts and automated test suites. • Integrated the React front end with backend services and UI components via GraphQL. • Designed end-to-end system flows and platform architecture.

Lead Engineer — SuperWorld

May 2020 – Sep 2025 • California, USA Technologies: MERN (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js), Solidity, Web3.js, Polygon, Ethereum

Built a virtual real estate map and NFT marketplace web application on the MERN stack. • Developed, deployed, tested, and audited Solidity smart contracts on the Polygon network. • Integrated smart contracts with the MERN application using Web3.js. • Implemented payment gateways and third-party service integrations. • Led a team of 5 junior engineers and conducted code reviews of their work.

PROJECTS

Decentralized Land Record Management — A blockchain-based land management system built for the Government of Odisha (Department of Science and Technology) to securely record and verify land ownership. (Blockchain, Solidity, Smart Contracts)

SuperWorld Map — A virtual real estate platform where properties are bought, sold, and traded as NFTs on the Polygon network. (MERN, Solidity, Web3.js, Polygon, Ethereum)

• DOMX — A phygital, asset-backed NFT purchase platform enabling investors to buy NFTs via on-ramp payment

integration. (Web3, NFT, Payment On-ramp)

Distributed Doctor Application — A distributed health record management system built on blockchain to secure and streamline medical records (B.Tech Major Project). (Blockchain, Solidity)

Process_Lineage — A blockchain-based process lineage and control tool for supply chain traceability (developed for Dell Technologies hiring track). (Blockchain, Supply Chain)

PUBLICATIONS

COVID-19 Database on Consortium Blockchain — Google Scholar • Doctel: Leveraging Blockchain for Secure and Immutable Electronic Health Record Management — Google Scholar

EDUCATION

B.Tech, Computer Science Engineering — IIIT Bhubaneswar, India CGPA: 8.80 / 10 (Top 3% of batch) Higher Secondary (XII) — Navy Children School - 95% Matriculation (X) — Navy Children School - 95 %

LEADERSHIP & ACTIVITIES

Founder & Advisor, Metaverse Chapter, IIIT Bhubaneswar • Placement Coordinator, IIIT Bhubaneswar • PR Head, Advaita (College Fest), IIIT Bhubaneswar

2018 – 2022

2016 – 2018 2014 – 2016
